coder_notes: First-in-human basket of DB-1311/BNT324 (B7-H3 ADC). No GBM-specific cohort; GBM appears in inclusion criterion 3 (RANO 2.0 for GBM subjects) and outcome definitions, implying GBM patients can enrol (likely via 'other solid tumors' or 'rare tumor' cohorts). Lopinavir/ritonavir (fixed-dose combination, split) and itraconazole are given in a DDI sub-study (Dose Expansion 15) to test their effect on DB-1311 PK; coded delivery_enabling_agent as the nearest role (exposure-modifying, no antitumour hypothesis), flagged. Enzalutamide/abiraterone are novel hormone therapy partners in prostate cohorts 16-18 (patients previously on NHT); coded soc_backbone as background prostate therapy, though they could be read as experimental_combination partners. Regimen coded combination because some experimental arms combine DB-1311 with NHT; GBM-relevant cohorts are DB-1311 monotherapy. PK is plasma only. B7-H3 measurement is baseline target expression (no entry threshold), not target modulation.
